scene.title: From the machine to the part
scene.lead: A lockstitch hook assembly, taken apart the way a parts book shows it. Every numbered part is a category we stock, listed under its OEM part number.
scene.figAria: Exploded technical drawing of a lockstitch hook assembly: 1 rotary hook, 2 bobbin case, 3 bobbin, 4 feed dog, 5 presser foot, 6 needle.

notes.hook: Catches the needle thread to form each stitch. A worn point means skipped stitches.
notes.bobbinCase: Holds the bobbin; its spring sets the lower-thread tension.
notes.bobbin: Carries the lower thread. Must match the hook type.
notes.feedDog: Moves the fabric between stitches. Tooth pitch suits the fabric weight.
notes.presserFoot: Holds the fabric on the feed dog — standard, compensating or special.
notes.needle: System and size (e.g. DB×1 #14) must match machine and fabric.

quote.heading: How quoting works
quote.sub: Prices depend on quantity and delivery, so every order gets a formal quote.

1.title: Add parts to your list

2.title: Send the list — or a photo

trust.heading: Before you order
trust.sub: How we work, in plain terms.
trust.deliveryBody: Dispatched from Dhaka by courier to anywhere in Bangladesh, or collect from us. Ask on WhatsApp for the time to your area.
trust.genuine: Made or approved by the machine maker, under the original part number. Best for electronics, timing parts and anything under warranty.

about.metaDescription: Rakib Enterprise is based in Dhaka and supplies genuine and compatible spare parts for industrial sewing machines to garment factories, workshops and mechanics — with formal quotes, VAT invoices and delivery.
about.title: Spare parts for the machines that keep garment lines running.
about.lead: Based in Dhaka, we supply spare parts for industrial sewing machines to garment factories, maintenance teams, workshops and mechanics.

story.p1: When a machine stops, a line stops. Our work is getting the right part to the floor quickly — the correct part number, for the right machine, genuine or a compatible part made to the same specification.
story.p2: We work from part numbers, machine models and photos of the old part. If we are not sure a part fits, we ask before we quote.

about.stockSub: Parts for these machine brands, by part type — all searchable by part number.
about.policySub: You always know which one you are buying.

policy.genuineBody: Made or approved by the machine manufacturer and sold under the original part number. We recommend these for electronics, timing parts and machines under warranty.
policy.compatibleBody: Made by specialist manufacturers to the OEM dimensions and part number — needles, hooks, feed dogs, knives. Same fit, often easier to get.
policy.labelBody: Every listing shows the parts brand, the grade and the OEM part number. Quotes state the same, line by line.

about.processSub: From the first message to the part on the machine.

1.title: Send what you have
1.body: A part number, a list, an Excel sheet or a photo of the old part — on WhatsApp, by phone or through the quote form.

2.title: We identify the part
2.body: We match it to the OEM part number and your machine model, and say whether genuine, compatible or both are available.

3.title: Formal quote
3.body: A written quote with prices, quantities and delivery time — usually the same day.

4.title: Order and invoice
4.body: Confirm the quote. We issue a VAT invoice against your BIN on request. Pay by bank transfer, bKash, Nagad or cash on delivery.

5.title: Dispatch from Dhaka
5.body: Packed with the part number on every bag and sent by courier, or ready for collection.

about.contactBody: Send a part number or a photo of the old part and we will tell you what fits.
